Hi Samir / Li / Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive with our SE team. To keep this focused we want a single 60-minute session that includes your architects + our Solutions Engineers to walk through: deployment patterns, KV cache behavior for long convo contexts, and a brief perf profile for your likely request mix.

Because your team is distributed (US/EU/APAC) I sketched the most likely overlap windows and attached an availability spreadsheet so you can mark preferred slots. A couple notes up front:
- DST differences are still catching people out — I flagged the US/EU conversion that flips on Nov 1 and wanted to confirm we all interpret the same wall-clock time.
- Our SEs (Marissa and Ben) can take either an early US slot or a late EU slot; they prefer not to be after 8:30pm local.

Proposed 60-minute windows (times shown as UTC / local examples):
- 13:00 UTC (08:00 PST / 14:00 CET / 21:00 SGT) — early for US, good overlap EU->APAC
- 16:00 UTC (11:00 PST / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT) — mid-day EU, late APAC (likely bad)
- 20:00 UTC (15:00 PST / 21:00 CET / 05:00 SGT+1) — late for EU, overnight for APAC

Can you please: 1) open the attached atlas-architects-avail.xlsx and mark who must attend vs optional, and 2) indicate preferred slot(s) and any hard blocks? I can then coordinate a concrete invite (proposed ICS attached).

If it helps, Marissa can do a short pre-call with your lead architect to align agenda before the full session.

Thanks — Connor

- Tom (EU infra) is flexible but prefers afternoons CET (14:00-17:00).
- I (US) can do early morning PST (07:00-09:30 PST) or late evening (after 18:30 PST) if needed.

I also noted that Nov 1 DST change created confusion on our side — we used local clocks when filling the sheet, but flagged ambiguous rows. Please treat the spreadsheet as authoritative for availability (I added timezone columns).

Two asks from us:
1) Can you propose one firm slot that hits at least one EU mid-afternoon and is inside Li's APAC range (after 09:00 SGT)?
2) If the only workable time is late for your SEs, can we do a 30m pre-call with Marissa to cover the heavy infra topics and then have the full 60m for hands-on and walkthrough?
